parameters.description:
`msg-to-popcornnotify` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your PopcornNotify destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own PopcornNotify destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional PopcornNotify destinations bound per enrollment.

Enter the phone number(s) (in international format) and/or email address(es) you want this notification delivered to; PopcornNotify accepts a mix of both in the same recipient list.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment PopcornNotify recipients, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your PopcornNotify recipients
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own PopcornNotify destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

recipients_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's POPCORNNOTIFY_RECIPIENTS value (same format as POPCORNNOTIFY_RECIPIENTS)
